target: Historical tAge application to GSE304044 GSTA4 mouse RPE
planning_context: Retrospective preparation: the authors' aggregate 8.5-month reduction is already known. Freeze numerical comparisons before obtaining new replay outputs.
historical_tolerances: UNRESOLVED: obtain precision and units from the historical implementation and justify tolerances before new outputs.
execution_policy: Read JSON/CSV and hash bytes only. Never download, import, execute, unpack or deserialize supplied code/models.
reference_ready: BLOCKED until the historical implementation is identified and a separately reviewed adapter exists; complete manifest declarations alone do not establish this.
reference_pass: BLOCKED in this preparation release. Externally supplied output agreement is a numerical check, not verified execution.
study_calculation: NOT_RUN: require reference PASS, an accepted study manifest, independent-unit mapping, frozen analysis and reviewed execution.
biological_interpretation: INCONCLUSIVE: clock agreement alone cannot establish recovery, safety, function or human translation.
synthetic_policy: Synthetic examples test software only. They cannot yield reference reproduction PASS or biological PASS.
comparison_rule: For every exact reference_sample_id key: abs(observed - expected) <= absolute_tolerance + relative_tolerance * abs(expected). No rounding, fitting, averaging or dropping rows.
matrix_policy: The supplied fixture is an already-preprocessed model-input matrix. Require the complete declared sample-by-gene product, finite values, explicit one-to-one mappings and a contiguous model feature order. Do not impute, center or transform values.
provenance_policy: Hashes establish byte identity. Authority, historical equivalence, preprocessing completeness and appropriate tolerances remain human-review obligations. Preserve received correspondence privately when needed; do not publish it by default.
